verdict.rationale: Snowflake's first-party 'Regulatory compliance' docs have per-certification pages covering SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS, plus ISO 27001/27017/27018, SOC 1 Type II, FedRAMP Moderate/High and CSA STAR. That gives security reviewers documented attestations for two of the three named frameworks. missing for 10: any HIPAA documentation in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of the attestation pages.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, compliance attestations (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI) are documented so security review does not stall the rollout

citations.quote: Snowflake is committed to meeting industry-standard regulatory compliance requirements
SOC 1 Type II, SOC 2 Type II, FedRAMP (Moderate and High), and PCI DSS
